# A real `apt-get install -y podman uidmap openssh-client` on Debian trixie, trimmed to three
# packages per pass so the whole run is readable. NOT hand-written prose: the point of a fixture
# here is that the anchors are matched against the shapes apt really prints, which is ERRORS.md
# B19's lesson -- the STOP box came apart for two years because nothing had ever fed box() what
# podman actually says, only what messages.txt says.
#
# THE THREE PASSES ARE WHY THIS IS FOUR PHASES. apt downloads the whole set, then unpacks the
# whole set, then configures the whole set, so `Get:`, `Unpacking ` and `Setting up ` are three
# disjoint stretches rather than three lines per package. Reordering them here would make the
# suite agree with a phase model apt does not have.
#
# ONE LINE CARRIES AN ESCAPE SEQUENCE, deliberately. apt writes plain lines when its stdout is a
# pipe -- which it is here, since setup_run tees it -- but apt HOOKS do not care: needrestart and
# apt-listchanges are on Ubuntu by default and colour their own output. The live box strips it;
# without a line like this nothing would prove that.
#
# W: AND E: LINES GO TO STDERR, which is where apt really puts them -- and the reason
# setup_run redirects. Without one line of it in here nothing would notice a 2>&1 going
# missing, and the block would smear the first time a mirror was slow.
#
# Lines from column 0 starting with `#` are notes to staff and are stripped by the replayer,
# the same rule the three message catalogues follow.
